status: SIGNED - author accepted the arcasHLA deployment diagnosis and chose to report as is in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-25

decision.choice: No amendment. The v3.5.0 arcasHLA deployment (single-end extraction of paired-end RNA-seq, arcasHLA 0.2.0 container with a runtime align.py patch) is reported as is: its rerun result stays in the primary registry and the manuscript describes the defect, the truth-free comparison with the stored calls, and the discovery path in Limitations.
decision.not_done: No --paired fix, no new release and no arcasHLA sensitivity rerun is made for this paper. Any later change to the arcasHLA deployment needs a new signed amendment and is reported as a labelled sensitivity, never as a replacement of the primary result.
decision.discovery_path: The deployment was diagnosed only after the truth-derived registry delta had been seen; the diagnosis itself uses container contents, module code and caller outputs only. Choosing not to amend keeps the primary result independent of that score.

authorization.signed: 2026-10-25, explicit author statement: 'I accept the report for arcashla'
